title: test(spec): repo-radius retirement walks read what git does not ignore, so a docs-built checkout no longer runs them red
body:
Fixes #23156

Clause-②: no

## What this changes

Four `@objectstack/spec` repo-project tree walks read the raw filesystem. On a checkout that had built the docs, they went red on correct sources, because they read the generated, gitignored `content/docs/protocol-upgrade/` pages that `gen:upgrade-guide` writes. Those pages name retired keys and defs, because that is their job.

The four walks now take their file list from one shared test-only helper, `packages/spec/scripts/lib/repo-walk-testkit.ts` (`listRepoWalkFiles`). The helper lists what git does not ignore: `git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard`, run in each walked directory. Each walk's `SKIPPED_DIRS` / dot-directory rule still applies below the root, so the change only narrows the set and never widens it.

- `packages/spec/src/api/export-job-family-retirement.test.ts`
- `packages/spec/src/system/compliance-families-retirement.test.ts`
- `packages/spec/src/integration/connector-connection-timeout-retirement.test.ts`
- `packages/spec/src/data/currency-mode-family-closure.pin.test.ts` (the corpus for rules A and B)

The pin is `packages/spec/scripts/lib/repo-walk-testkit.test.ts`, registered in `packages/spec/vitest.repo-tests.json`. It reads the real checkout, so `check:cross-package-test-inputs` requires that registration.

No product code, no docs generator, no `.gitignore`.

## H1: which walks read the directory (measured at `cb9841aa2`)

- `git grep -l SKIPPED_DIRS packages/spec/src` returns **28** files.
- **27** of them walk a root that contains `content/docs/protocol-upgrade/`: 26 walk `content`, and the currency pin walks `content/docs`.
- The one that does not is `kernel/metadata-type-registry-allow-org-override-absence`, which walks `packages` and `examples` only.
- None of the 28 names the directory, so **all 27 read it today**.
- With the generated pages on disk, **4 of 28 go red**. These are the card's four, and each names only `content/docs/protocol-upgrade/18.md`. The other **23 stay green**, because their matchers do not fire on the current page content. They have the same latent defect. Each is a separate walk closure, not a one-line fold, so they are left for the seat (see Acceptance notes).

## H2: the route, and why

**Route: read what git does not ignore (tracked, plus untracked-not-ignored), not a skip by directory name.**

1. **A tracked fixture is not possible under `content/docs/protocol-upgrade/`.** Both checks were measured at `cb9841aa2`:
   - With a fixture force-added there, `node scripts/git-merge-regen.mjs --self-test` (part of `check:merge-driver`) exits 1: "content/docs/protocol-upgrade/** — declared untracked, but git tracks 1 file(s)". `scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs` registers the tree as untracked.
   - With a file the generator did not write present there, `gen:upgrade-guide` exits 1: "holds files this generator did not write (fixture.md); refusing to replace it". That breaks the docs build.

   So the fixture is necessarily gitignored and untracked, and both routes leave such a fixture green. The H2 premise, that the fixture is tracked and so only a name skip can leave it green, does not hold.
2. **A name skip leaves a sibling red.** The publish lane's single-file copy, `packages/spec/protocol-upgrade-guide.md`, is gitignored too. Generated locally (`build-upgrade-guide.ts --out`), it turns **3 of the same 4** red: export-job, compliance and connector. The currency pin's roots do not reach `packages/spec/`. A `protocol-upgrade` name skip would not cover it. The git reading covers both outputs, plus any future gitignored generator output.
3. **The walk now equals CI's view and turbo's input hash.** `.gitignore` is the one register of "generated, not authored", and turbo already hashes inputs through git. Tracked files are listed whatever `.gitignore` says, and a page not yet `git add`ed is still judged.
4. **Cost.** One `git ls-files` per walked root, about 30 ms over the five-root radius. On a built checkout at `cb9841aa2`, the five-root radius gained 0 files and lost 1,537, every one of them ignored (`packages/spec/json-schema/` and the generated migration registry).

The helper is loud and never returns empty. A missing root, a root that is a file, or a git failure (for example, a `.git` file pointing nowhere, exit 128) throws. A path git lists that is gone from disk is left out, and any other stat fault is re-raised. The git child runs with `gitFreeEnv()`.

The helper takes **one directory**, and each walk keeps its `for (const root of WALK_ROOTS)` loop over `path.join(REPO_ROOT, root)`. That is the spelling `check:cross-package-test-inputs` folds into the walked roots it checks against the declared globs. A first draft that passed `REPO_ROOT` read as a walk from the repo root and turned that gate red.

## The fixture and its pin

The fixture is a page naming the retired key `connector.connectionTimeoutMs`. It is an excerpt of the generated protocol-18 line that turned the connector walk red. It sits at `content/docs/protocol-upgrade/18.md` inside a throwaway git repository whose `.gitignore` carries the real repository's two lines for the guide's outputs. This follows the sandbox shape of `scripts/check-role-word.mjs`'s skipped-subtree battery. The pin asserts the exact listing:

- The fixture is **not** listed, and neither is the same page at `packages/spec/protocol-upgrade-guide.md`. A positive control first proves both files are on disk.
- The same page **is** listed where git keeps it (`content/docs/guides/upgrade.md`, `packages/spec/README.md`).
- A sibling `content/docs/protocol-upgrade-draft/` (untracked, not ignored) **is** listed. The exclusion is a path, never a string prefix.
- A force-added file under an ignored directory **is** listed, because tracked wins over `.gitignore`, as in CI.
- A directory the caller skips by name is not listed, and a tracked file deleted from the work tree is not listed.
- The real checkout ignores both generated paths (`git check-ignore`, with a tracked page as the control). On a docs-built checkout, nothing listed under `content/` lies in the generated tree.

The retired key is assembled at runtime in the pin, because the connector walk reads every `.ts` under `packages/`.

## Evidence

All runs below went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.

- **Red first** (`cb9841aa2`, generated pages on disk): 28 walk files, `4 failed | 24 passed`. Each red names `content/docs/protocol-upgrade/18.md`: export-job `, CreateExportJobResult,`, compliance `, ChangePrioritySchema,`, connector `.connectionTimeoutMs`, currency rule B `18.md:24`.
- **Single-file copy only** (`cb9841aa2`): `3 failed | 25 passed`, each naming `packages/spec/protocol-upgrade-guide.md`.
- **Green after** (`821bdf262`, both generated outputs on disk): the 28 walk files plus the pin, `29 passed (29)`, `440 passed (440)`.
- **Full spec repo project**, run at `821bdf262` and again at the merge head `7310df0d3` with both outputs regenerated on disk: `61 passed (61)`, `1033 passed (1033)` both times.
- **Spec local project:** it contains none of the changed files. All five changed test files are listed in `vitest.repo-tests.json`, and only they import the helper.
- **`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`**, at `821bdf262` and at `7310df0d3`: exit 0 both times. This covers `tsc`, `check:scripts-typecheck` and `check:test-typecheck`.
- **Ablation, one, on the ignore** (`821bdf262`): `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` dropped `'--exclude-standard'` from the listing. The anchor went 1 to 0 and the blob changed from `7e3d5ac986bd` to `7d27aa5a9e14`. The run ended `6 failed | 36 passed`, across 5 of 5 files:
  - in the pin, the sandbox listing gains exactly `content/docs/protocol-upgrade/18.md` and `packages/spec/protocol-upgrade-guide.md`, and the real-checkout case lists the four generated pages;
  - all four walks go red on both generated outputs.

  The restore was proven: the blob equals HEAD (`7e3d5ac986bd`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The helper's blob is the same at `7310df0d3`.

## Gates (local, at the PR head `7310df0d3`)

The head merges `origin/main` `394f65e89`; the merge was clean and touched none of this PR's files.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived **78** commands. The PM's lead at `cb9841aa2` had 77; the extra one is `pnpm check:pm-governed-merges`. All 78 were run after a turbo build of the workspace minus docs and console, and all 78 exited 0. `--ran` reports: "78 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 78 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". That includes `check:api-surface` ("public API surface + factory signatures unchanged") and `check:cross-package-test-inputs` (OK, 13 walked roots judged).
- The local-only `pnpm check:dev-prereqs`: exit 0.
- CI families: this PR's check-runs.

## Changeset

None. Nothing in the diff ships. `@objectstack/spec`'s `files[]` carries `src/**/*.zod.ts` and no `*.test.ts`, `scripts/` or `vitest.repo-tests.json`. After the rebuild, `listRepoWalkFiles` appears in 0 files under `dist/`; the control `retiredKey` appears in 68. No `.changeset/*.md` is touched. Label: `skip-changeset`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Latent, same class, not folded in (outside this card's file surface).** These 23 repo-radius walks read the gitignored guide today. They stay green only because the current pages do not match their matchers. A future major's page could turn any of them red, and so could a new walk copied from them:
  - `ai/agent-lifecycle-retirement`, `ai/agent-memory-store-retirement`
  - `api/rest-api-config-dead-keys-retirement`
  - `contracts/record-share-guest-recipient-census`
  - `data/cube-member-inner-name-retirement`, `data/cube-refresh-key-retirement`, `data/document-schemas-retirement`, `data/object-external-sharing-model-retirement`
  - `integration/connector-resilience-keys-retirement`, `integration/connector-sync-retirement`, `integration/connector-triggers-retirement`
  - `qa/requires-plugins-retirement`
  - `security/rls-tags-retirement`
  - `system/email-template-category-is-system-retirement`
  - `ui/element-flat-binding-retirement`, `ui/element-text-variant-heading-retirement`, `ui/form-field-public-picker-retirement`, `ui/master-detail-detail-sort-field-retirement`, `ui/object-grid-resizable-columns-retirement`, `ui/page-header-breadcrumb-retirement`, `ui/view-data-api-provider-retirement`, `ui/view-item-owner-hidden-retirement`, `ui/view-list-tabs-retirement`

  Each fix is the same move: replace the walk closure with `listRepoWalkFiles`. Carrier: none.
- **Redundant exclusions, kept on purpose.** In the four walks, the `json-schema/`, `spec-changes.json` and tsup `*.bundled_*.mjs` exclusions are now unreachable through the git listing. They are kept, and the two comments that described the walk as a filesystem walk were corrected. The connector `json-schema/` entry's reason is the generated content, not the ignore. The compliance tsup guard keeps its own narrowness test.
- **File surface.** `packages/spec/vitest.repo-tests.json` (+1 line) is outside the claim's named files. `check:cross-package-test-inputs` requires an escaping test to be listed in the repo project, so the pin's registration comes with it.
